 Order

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.48/2024 dated 02.03.2024 registered at Police Station Bhangarh District Bina for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376(3), 376(2)(N) and 506 of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.
2. Leaned counsel for the applicant contends that the applicant and the prosecutrix were known to each other since one year and they were in touch on phone.
The applicant is aged about 22 years and he is in custody since 11.03.2024.
The FSL report is also negative.
Therefore, considering the totality of circumstances, the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: 3. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent has opposed the prayer and submitted that the date of birth of the prosecutrix is 10.06.2008 and she was undoubtedly minor on the date of incident.
Therefore, considering the serious allegations against the applicant, the application deserves to be dismissed.

4. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.
5.
It is evident that the applicant and the prosecurtrix were in relationship for one year.
It is also undisputed that the applicant himself is aged about 22 years having no criminal past.
The FSL report is negative.
6. Thus taking into considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the considered view that it is a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.

8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
9.
Accordingly, M.Cr.C. stands disposed of.
(MANINDER S. BHATTI) JUDGE mn Prabhat @ Prabhas @ Pramod Bansal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68281918/
